citation.authors: Ali A, Gurney, Brouner, Spendiff, Malaguti, Candow, Wijesekara, Yoon, et al.
citation.title: Effects of Acute Ecklonia cava Supplementation on Submaximal Cycling and Repeated-Sprint Performance in Trained Cyclists: A Randomised Double-Blind Placebo-Controlled Crossover Trial

population.description: Twelve trained male cyclists (cycling 8 +/- 2 h/week for at least two years; VO2max 50.0 +/- 8.4 mL/kg/min). Excluded: current smoking, history of cardiovascular or metabolic disease, musculoskeletal injury, antihypertensive medication; the paper does not call them healthy and ran no glucose test, so 'healthy' rests on that history screening.

protocols.name: cycling_60min_placebo
protocols.description: Placebo arm of the crossover: 150 mL sugar-free cordial diluted 1:4 with water (no carbohydrate printed, entered as no meal), then 30 min seated, then 60 min cycling at 55% of each rider's WRmax at 80 rpm (Methods). Minute 0 is the drink, so cycling is minutes 30 to 90. Intensity from the measured VO2 of the placebo condition, Table 1: 30.4 mL/kg/min (mean of the three 20-min exercise intervals), level = (30.4 - 3.7) / 31.7 = 0.842. The paper prints no pre-exercise fast or meal (only that diet was replicated from a 3-day record), so the arm starts from typical values (norm_center) and the clock hour is assumed.

findings.description: Heart rate over the 60 min of cycling, placebo condition: participant-level mean of the three 20-min intervals (0-20, 20-40, 40-60 min of exercise), so the window is the whole bout, minutes 30 to 90 of the arm

location.where: Table 1, row 'Heart rate', column Placebo, Mean +/- SD

left_out.what: Blood glucose and lactate, session mean over rest, 20, 40 and 60 min of cycling (Table 1); the rest sample's time is not printed, and the pre-exercise fasted or fed state is not described
RER during cycling (Table 1): depends on the pre-exercise meal and diet, which the paper does not describe (diet only 'replicated' from a 3-day record)
VO2 in mL/kg/min during cycling (Table 1); used as the bout's intensity input, and the unit is not in the loader's table (marker is mL/min)

Repeated 20 s maximal sprints: mean and peak power (Table 2, about 600 and 780 W, beyond the activity scale) and the post-sprint glucose and lactate (Table 2) sampled in the second minute of each 4-min recovery
Maximum work rate WRmax in watts and the 55% work rate in watts: not printed (only VO2max 50.0 +/- 8.4 mL/kg/min, and the VO2 measured during the bout, which was used)
